summary.text: The committee reviewed the common-area electricity analysis. Alert period: 2026-03. Runtime reference period: 2025-03. Electricity billed changed by 6.7% compared with the same month a year earlier. The leading assessment is Pressure switch likely faulty or stuck (evidence confidence: high). This is an evidence-based hypothesis rather than proof of a confirmed fault, and the stated confidence should guide any decision. Recommended next steps are Inspect and replace the pump pressure switch and controller relay; Check tanks and pipes for leakage or overflow; Install a sub-meter on the pump (measure instead of estimate). Estimated excess pump use is 658 kWh, with a potential monthly saving of ₹6,455 if that excess is removed. The committee should confirm the diagnosis before committing expenditure and compare subsequent bills and logged operation after any repair. Differences between estimated equipment consumption and billed units also need continued investigation. These figures are estimates from synthetic data in this demo. Actual savings depend on measured operation and successful corrective work; they are not guaranteed.
